evidence.V6: Leaf green in two values (midrib split) plus bark brown in two values for rings and darker coconuts; disciplined, good contrast; autumn/frost colourways swap cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1812 tris vs tree target 2000 (ceiling 5000): at target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, smooth weighted shading, value-banded palette and bevelled forms consistent with the kit.
